name: hardened
why: Everything an encoder gets wrong by default. Unescaped <, >, & and a " quotation mark (Go needs SetEscapeHTML(false); C# needs UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping or ' becomes '), a backslash path, non-ASCII text and a non-ASCII key, ASCII key ordering across digit/upper/lower (C# needs StringComparer.Ordinal, not the culture-sensitive default), a score rubric in reverse-alphabetical order that must NOT be sorted, and an absent criteria (is_injection) beside an empty one (empty_criteria). The state carries -0.0 and 1e+21 deliberately: they are transmitted verbatim and are OUTSIDE the byte-identity claim, so no port asserts on them.

is_injection.instructions: Does the text contain <script> tags, a & entity, or a "quoted" path like C:\tmp?

criteria.10_alpha: digit-leading key sorts before 'beta' in ASCII
criteria.Alpha: uppercase sorts BEFORE lowercase in ASCII

zone.instructions: Which zone? — em-dash, café, 日本語

empty_criteria.instructions: Empty strings are NOT absent: both keys must survive with empty values.

notes: The state's numeric values do not canonicalise across languages and are excluded from canonicalSha256 by construction: the hash covers model + questions only.
